name: Keyboard Warrior: Talk Smack Get Smacked
detailed_description:
A top-down action RPG where you play as an ordinary person who’s endured relentless cyberbullying—until today. No more silence. No more taking it. Now, it’s time to fight back and make those cowardly trolls pay!

The Revenge Begins!

Fed up with the endless hate, you’ve compiled a hit list of every online bully who ever crossed you. Armed with your mechanical keyboard and riding into battle on your gaming chair-turned-war machine, you’ll hunt them down in the real world. Find these loudmouths who talk big online but cower offline—and shut them up for good.

Fight Your Way.

Choose from brutal melee combos, ranged attacks, or even unleash savage verbal burns ("Keyboard Smash" ability, anyone?). Each level features a unique boss fight that demands new tactics: Will you overpower them with brute force, or outsmart them with cunning? The choice is yours.

Make them regret every word.

This time—you are the keyboard warrior they should fear.

Gameplay Overview

A top-down RPG where you take control of a victim of constant online harassment. One day, you snap—and decide to strike back.

Track down every anonymous troll who ever attacked you, arming yourself with your trusty keyboard and transforming your office chair into a battle-ready vehicle. Hunt them one by one, confront them in the real world, and put an end to their abuse—permanently.

With a variety of weapons (melee and ranged) and combat styles, you’ll adapt your approach to crush each unique boss. Some may fall to sheer aggression; others might require strategy. Good luck—and happy hunting.

short_description: Have you ever been attacked by keyboard warriors online? Have you felt furious because you couldn’t fight back? Today—right now—your chance has come! Make them feel your wrath! Shut them up, make them fear, make them tremble, and unleash your most intense revenge!
